svg.title: DEMO: resealing tray rims interrupts the bypass while preserving upward tray removal.
svg.desc: R and S each have two open-top mesh-bottom trays, A above B. Lid-gasket sections lie only at wall contacts. R has a continuous side bypass and S seals each tray rim. The separate stopped, drained service state shows the same empty upper tray above its vacant seat, lift upward and insertion downward, with the lower tray remaining. A circle on the removed tray marks its tab; a circle attached to the chamber wall ledge marks the chamber guide. The circles mark interfaces, not actual mating shapes or a geometrical proof of reversed-insertion rejection.
